attributes.name: Application
attributes.value: This product is intended for indoor use. It provides protection to personnel against access to hazardous parts. In addition, it protects the equipment inside the enclosure against introduction of solid foreign objects, falling dirt and water. It is designed for use in a standing or sitting position, supports both single and dual access, and boasts a top that opens for easier accessibility. For Details about the Design, Performance Expectations, Applications and Design Suggestions - See Design Considerations www.saginawcontrol.com/instman/considerations.pdf
